title: Schedule item (wire)
description: A schedule item as it appears in command replies (scheduleToWire). date is the day the item occurs on, which for a repeating item is not the day it was created. For the full export see export.schema.json, $defs/ScheduleItem.

date.description: The day the item occurs on, YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: End time, HH:MM. Present only when the item has one.
